As AI handles the documentation of incidents and the monitoring of sales areas, you become a specialist in high-stakes human interaction. When the system flags a potential threat, you apply your human intuition and de-escalation skills to handle the situation—tasks AI cannot perform. You will use predictive analytics to identify high-risk periods and locations, transforming your workflow from reactive patrolling to proactive prevention. You are the final arbiter of justice and safety in the store, empowered by a digital 'second sight' that ensures nothing goes unnoticed.
